map.刀具修磨评估与寿命预估: Tool Regrind Assessment and Life Estimation
map.本工具用于修磨（磨刀/检测/寿命）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (regrinding / inspection / life) service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：刀具修磨与寿命评估（磨损/剩余寿命/处置）: 📚 Deep Dive: Tool Regrind and Life Assessment (Wear / Remaining Life / Disposal)
map.刀具维护排程：输入类型、材质、磨损量与已用次数，估剩余寿命与处置: Tool maintenance scheduling: input type, material, wear, and times used to estimate remaining life and disposal
map.成本控制：判断修磨还是报废，避免过早更换或带病使用: Cost control: decide regrind vs. scrap to avoid premature replacement or running while degraded
map.异常提示切削参数或冷却不合理: Abnormal value suggests unreasonable cutting parameters or cooling
map.算法：总寿命 = 基准寿命 × 材质系数（车刀2000/铣刀1500/钻头300: Algorithm: total life = base life × material factor (turning 2000 / milling 1500 / drill 3000 / reamer 5000 / gear 4000 cycles; carbide 1.0, HSS 0.5, ceramic 1.5, CBN 2.5, PCD 3.0); remaining life = total life − times used; wear rate = wear / 0.3 mm × 100%; wear ≥ 0.15 mm suggests regrind, ≥ 0.3 mm or remaining ≤ 0 suggests scrap.
map.例：车刀（硬质合金）磨损 0.1mm、已用 500 次 → 总寿命 2000 次: Example: turning tool (carbide) wear 0.1 mm, used 500 times → total life 2000, remaining 1500, wear rate 33.3% → keep using. Wear 0.2 mm, used 800 → remaining 200, wear rate 66.7% → needs regrind. Wear 0.32 mm → scrap and replace.
map.材质系数怎么来的？: How is the material factor derived?
map.为同尺寸刀具不同材质的相对耐磨系数（如 PCD 约为硬质合金 3 倍），由厂商寿: It is the relative wear-resistance coefficient of different materials for the same-size tool (e.g., PCD ≈ 3× carbide), given by vendor life data and field statistics; actual values follow the tool sample card.
map.磨损 0.3mm 就一定报废？: Does 0.3 mm wear always mean scrap?
map.0.3mm 为示例修磨/报废分界（对应磨损率 100%）；精加工或薄壁件阈值更严: 0.3 mm is an example regrind/scrap boundary (wear rate 100%); finishing or thin-wall parts have stricter thresholds — set by process requirement and edge condition.
map.刀具磨损量超过0.15mm建议修磨，超过0.3mm建议报废: Wear > 0.15 mm suggests regrind; > 0.3 mm suggests scrap
map.不同材质刀具寿命差异大，PCD寿命最长，HSS最短: Tool life varies greatly by material; PCD longest, HSS shortest
map.修磨后刀具寿命约为新刀的30%左右: Life after regrind is about 30% of a new tool
map.关于「修磨（磨刀/检测/寿命）服务」: About the Regrinding (Sharpening / Inspection / Life) Service
map.修磨（磨刀/检测/寿命）服务工具，输入刀具类型、材质、磨损量和已使用次数，自动评: The regrinding (sharpening / inspection / life) service tool inputs tool type, material, wear amount, and times used to automatically assess whether regrind or scrap is needed, estimates remaining life, and outputs regrind-parameter suggestions. Suitable for management and maintenance of cutting tools such as turning tools, milling cutters, drills, reamers, and gear cutters.
map.根据磨损量判断修磨或报废: Judge regrind or scrap by wear amount
map.考虑刀具类型和材质计算寿命: Compute life considering tool type and material
map.输出修磨砂轮和参数建议: Output regrind wheel and parameter suggestions
